integrity: Analytic result with reproducible algebraic checks. Verification is same-model only and not independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic equal-rate map on strictly positive quadrant; does not cover axis Ricker dynamics, stochastic perturbations or unequal-rate cases. The 2012 Kang preimage paper could not be fully inspected; bibliographic originality uncertainty remains.
title: Neutral coexistence selection and a sharp transverse barrier in the lottery–Ricker map
